people.name: Hothir
people.line: A son of Heman, a musician in David's court.

translations.web: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translations.bsb: the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
translations.kjv: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
translations.asv: for the one and twentieth to Hothir, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
